description: Static, append-only, self-verifying address index for open model weights
trust: no host is trusted; every file has a sha256 address and every manifest is named by its own blake3
verify: download file from files[].url, compute sha256, compare with files[].address
coverage: top Hugging Face models by downloads, public and ungated, refreshed daily

clients.holo-verify: HOLO_VERIFY_PIN=<pinned or latest json> makes huggingface_hub downloads verify offline
